title: Burrata vs Mozzarella: The Creamy Difference That Changes Nutrition

seo.title: Burrata vs Mozzarella: Nutrition and Texture
seo.meta_description: Burrata has a cream-filled center, so it is usually higher in fat and calories and lower in protein than fresh mozzarella, although brand formulas vary.
seo.search_intent: Compare burrata and mozzarella by production, fat, calories, protein, and use.

excerpt: Burrata wraps cream and shredded cheese inside a mozzarella-like shell. That usually means more fat and calories and less protein per 100 g than fresh mozzarella, although product labels vary.
content_html:
Burrata and fresh mozzarella look like close relatives because they are. The difference appears when you cut into burrata: its mozzarella-like shell holds stracciatella and cream, which usually makes burrata higher in fat and calories and lower in protein per ounce.

The center changes the nutrition

Fresh mozzarella is a pasta-filata cheese throughout. Burrata adds shredded cheese curds and cream inside that shell. More cream means more fat and less protein density.

Typical numbers overlap but the pattern is clear

Fresh mozzarella commonly falls around 240–280 calories, 18–22 g fat, and 16–20 g protein per 100 g. Burrata often runs closer to 280–330 calories, 24–30 g fat, and 10–15 g protein. Brand formulas vary enough that the package label is worth checking.

Serving size matters

A single burrata ball may weigh 4 ounces or more and is often served as a centerpiece. That can turn a modest per-ounce difference into a meaningful difference on the plate.

They cook differently too

Mozzarella is built for slicing, melting, and stretching. Burrata is at its best when the cool creamy center can spill into tomatoes, bread, or vegetables; prolonged heat removes much of what makes it distinct.

The practical choice

Fresh mozzarella usually gives you more protein for fewer calories; burrata gives you a richer, cream-filled texture.

faq.question: Which has more fat, burrata or mozzarella?
faq.answer: Burrata usually does because its center contains cream.

faq.question: Which has more protein?
faq.answer: Fresh mozzarella usually provides more protein per 100 g.

faq.question: Are burrata and mozzarella the same cheese?
faq.answer: No. Burrata has a mozzarella-like outer shell filled with stracciatella and cream.
